These services are paid per use. Every question costs a transcription, an answer and, if it is spoken, the synthesis of it. You are billed by OpenAI or xAI on your own account, not through this app. Keep an eye on it and use a key with a spending limit.
Hearing and speaking always go to OpenAI: xAI publishes no transcription or speech service.
Without an OpenAI key the assistant cannot hear you, whichever service answers.

Only a long press, and only if the wheel\'s broadcast reaches this app while it is closed — the diagnostics screen tells you in three minutes.\n\nLeave it off if you use Android Auto. With a phone connected the long press belongs to Google Assistant, and both would open at once: this app hears the wheel, it does not take it from anyone.
Since %1$s: %2$d questions, %3$.1f minutes listened, %4$.1fk tokens, %5$.1fk characters spoken.
The figures go back to zero and start again from today. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing about your account changes — this is only what this app has counted.
This app answers on your own account, with your own key. The easiest way in is a file: save the key in a text file — any name will do — get it onto the car, and press From a file.
This build carries a key of its own, so it works without one being entered. Enter yours and it takes over.

A file can arrive on a USB stick or in the Download folder. One downloaded with MG4 Browser works too, but import it straight away: the browser clears its own downloads.\n\nGreen means the service answered when it was last asked, amber that a key is there but has not been accepted. Tap a service to check it again or remove it.
There is no key in the clipboard

Nothing was found to read a key from.\n\nSave the key in a text file — the name does not matter, mg4-key.txt is as good as any — and put it on a USB stick or in the Download folder. Downloading it with MG4 Browser works as well, as long as it is imported before the browser tidies its downloads away. The key can sit on a line of its own with anything else around it.
That is not a key. OpenAI keys begin with sk-, xAI keys with xai-.
To look through the files on this car — Download, a USB stick, what the browser downloaded — the app needs permission to read storage. It reads nothing else and sends nothing anywhere.

Where a key file would be looked for

For three minutes this screen keeps listening even when it is not in front, so that a press which opens the factory assistant still gets recorded. Everything that arrives is written down and survives the app being closed.\n\nWhile it runs, this app claims the media buttons, so play and pause may not reach the music player. It stops on its own after three minutes.
Watching. Go and press the wheel: short, long, and twice quickly.
Listens as soon as it opens: %1$s

A gesture that opens the app is only half a command if you then have to touch the screen, so it starts recording the moment it appears.\n\nIt stays quiet until a key is entered and the microphone has been allowed, and it never asks for the microphone by itself — so it cannot start at somebody on a car that is not set up yet.
